description: This script manages post-installation tasks for bundled plugins in a Node.js environment, including discovering runtime dependencies, checking source checkout status, and conditionally running npm installs to restore dependencies.

methods.name: readJson
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON file from a given path.

methods.name: dependencySentinelPath
methods.description: Constructs the path to a dependency's package.json in node_modules.

methods.name: collectRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Combines dependencies and optionalDependencies from a package.json object.

methods.name: discoverBundledPluginRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Discovers runtime dependencies of bundled plugins by scanning the extensions directory.

methods.name: createNestedNpmInstallEnv
methods.description: Creates a sanitized environment object for nested npm installs.

methods.name: isSourceCheckoutRoot
methods.description: Checks if the current directory is a source checkout root by verifying presence of .git, src, and extensions directories.

methods.name: shouldRunBundledPluginPostinstall
methods.description: Determines whether to run the postinstall process based on environment and directory state.

methods.name: runBundledPluginPostinstall
methods.description: Main function to run postinstall tasks, including dependency discovery and npm install if needed.
